slides.title: What this document covers
lines: OriginBA turns a client's Oracle Utilities C2M database (CISADM) into a governed reporting layer and delivers it through JasperReports Server: Ad Hoc domains, dashboards, standardized reports and scheduled exports, one org per client.

Two repositories carry it. originba_dbt owns the data layer: the dbt models, the Oracle-native build, nightly QA, the client registry and generated domains. OriginBA-3 owns delivery: hand-built domains, report packs, promotion tools, the snapshot layer, the portal.
Almost every step below is a command with a proof attached. The steps that are not are named as such, together with what it would take to close them.

columns.heading: Runs on a laptop
items: The nightlies need the VPN from one Mac: 93% of runs in the last 30 days were skipped
The CD workflow has failed 13 of 13 times: no reachable warehouse from GitHub
The fix is a runner inside the VCN (an OKE CronJob); the design notes exist, the job does not

columns.heading: Two reporting layers
items: Clients read the snapshot tables; the dbt warehouse is live only on INT_DEV and Ellensburg test
Generated domains exist for two targets but no server binds to them yet
Other clients wait on DBA approval for ORIGINBA_* schemas and a service account

columns.heading: Gaps in the tooling
items: No capacity-gate script; it is manual SQL
Standard Offering on prod for three of five clients
Standardized reports are not yet schedulable with relative dates
Schedule documentation disagrees in three places
